provenance.description: Public synthetic fixture only. All account IDs, original operation and provider IDs, timestamps, evidence and the key were invented for offline transport verification. No production data or credentials.
provenance.verification: PostgreSQL and GnuPG decrypt byte-for-byte to plaintext; SHA256 matches; GnuPG packet inspection confirms AES256 and ZLIB compression (algorithm 2).

reproduction.prerequisites: Use an isolated local PostgreSQL fixture database with pgcrypto in schema extensions. No production access or additional extensions are required.
reproduction.sql:
with rows as (
 select observed_at,evidence from jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) as source(observed_at text,evidence jsonb)
), packed as (
 select json_agg(rows order by evidence->>'id')::text as payload,
 count(*)::integer as row_count,count(distinct evidence->>'id')::integer as distinct_member_count,
 min(observed_at) as original_observed_at_min,max(observed_at) as original_observed_at_max
 from rows
), encrypted as (
 select packed.*,extensions.pgp_sym_encrypt_bytea(convert_to(payload,'UTF8'),$2::text,
  'compress-algo=2,compress-level=6,cipher-algo=aes256') as ciphertext from packed
)
select payload as plaintext,jsonb_build_object(
 'format','work-cohort-pgp-json-v1',
 'query_sha256',$3::text,'membership_sha256',$4::text,
 'row_count',row_count,'distinct_member_count',distinct_member_count,
 'original_observed_at_min',original_observed_at_min,'original_observed_at_max',original_observed_at_max,
 'raw_bytes',octet_length(convert_to(payload,'UTF8')),
 'plaintext_sha256',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(payload,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),
 'encrypted_bytes',octet_length(ciphertext),
 'encrypted_base64',replace(encode(ciphertext,'base64'),E'\n','')
) as envelope from encrypted;
reproduction.notes: PostgreSQL json_agg preserves the captured row text, including six fractional timestamp digits. PGP encryption uses randomized salt and therefore ciphertext changes on regeneration; plaintext, hashes, counts, timestamps and successful decryption must match.
